summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration work with Spark, particularly regarding features in Spark 4.1 and 4.2. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about partition statistics, the new manifest format in Iceberg v4, and the implementation of fine-grained access policies.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes on integration work
Discussion on total_record_count in partition statistics
Managing partition tuples in Iceberg v4 manifest format
Proposal for fine-grained read restrictions in loadTable
